fact: National Development Strategy 2, dated 27 November 2025 and covering January 2026 to December 2030, names civil registration (passports, births, deaths and marriages) first among the services whose decentralisation it will extend (para 1378), commits to scale up birth registration (para 1597) and says the High Performance Computing Centre already hosts the Civil Registry (para 1073); it does not name the computerisation of registry offices and gives no cost for any of this.
title: National Development Strategy 2 (NDS 2): January 2026 – December 2030
